Day-to-day board: [GitHub Project "OwnStudio dev map"](https://github.com/users/luizvilla/projects/2) (Status / Slice / Kind, sorted by Updated to spot stale work). ## Notes - **Domain:** OwnStudio, a Theia/Electron workbench for OwnTech power-electronics boards (Twist, Spin). Vocabulary in [GLOSSARY.md](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/step-5/slice-1-thread/GLOSSARY.md); keep to it. Spec in [SPEC 2.0](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/step-5/slice-1-thread/SPEC.md), reasons in [ADRs](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/step-5/slice-1-thread/docs/adr/), every question asked in the [decision log](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/step-5/slice-1-thread/docs/decision-log.md). - **Skills to consult:** `grilling` and `domain-modeling` for HITL tickets; `tdd` for build tickets; `research` for research tickets. Dev skills written from [Choose which dev skills to write](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/27) join this list. - **This map carries execution (override of wayfinder's planning default).** `wayfinder:build` tickets are build units: their body is Unit / Done when / Test, not a question. Commits say `Refs #n`; the last one says `Closes #n`. A build ticket closes when its "done when" holds. - **plan.md** keeps rules, choices and rationale per slice; status lives on this map (from [Move plan.md's status onto the dev map](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/44) on). - **`wayfinder:luiz`** (👤) marks a ticket that can't move without Luiz: a decision, the bench with power on, or a retest. - **Claiming:** assign the ticket (always to luizvilla, since every session uses that account) **and** comment "claimed by , "; set the Project's Status to In Progress. Post "stopped at / next step" on the ticket at every commit, so a crash leaves a trail. A claimed ticket with no comment, commit or update for **3 days is stale** (⏳ red). - **Visual map:** redraw the diagram (colours and arrows) whenever a ticket opens, closes, is claimed or goes stale, and copy it into [docs/overview.md](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/step-5/slice-1-thread/docs/overview.md). [Dev map tooling](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/18) will generate both. - **Working style:** be critical; log each answered grilling round in the decision log, glossary, ADRs, benchmark and overview, and commit before the next round. - **Bench:** switching power on only with Luiz present, one run at a time, read the converter Mode back after every power run. Automated tests never set power on. - **Dev skill** (for the agents building OwnStudio) ≠ **setup skill** (slice 4, shipped in a user's setup). - Tickets in English. The repository is public: nothing sensitive in tickets (consent and DPO details stay out). ## Decisions so far - [Which recurring ways of working should become dev skills?](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/22): no root AGENTS.md exists, so it comes first; new dev skills: run-app, drive-app, bench (split with AGENTS.md), trial-intake, nine-steps, report; grilling rounds and dev map upkeep extend existing skills; resume, commit plan and retro are already covered. - [May OwnStudio redistribute the Claude agent SDK?](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/21): yes, under Anthropic's Commercial Terms: unmodified binary, the user's own account billed directly, no Claude branding; subscription login is unclear (only Anthropic can say), an API key is always fine; Codex is Apache-2.0 (ship LICENSE + NOTICE). - [Slice 1 rulings: navigation timing rule, Codex version, shipping the agent SDK](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/25): keep "95 % within 200 ms, none above 300 ms"; OwnStudio ships no agent, the AI tab installs Claude Code and Codex on first use with one click (pinned, probed); any Open VSX extension allowed, no shortlist; safety moves wholly to Power and agent shells. - [Can users install the Claude Code and Codex extensions themselves, and what does open extension install risk?](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/46): yes, from Open VSX (Microsoft's marketplace is closed to Theia); no redistribution, and subscription login is allowed; but user-installed agents run outside ADR 0031 (Claude Code starts in auto mode), one plugin host crash stops every extension, and a `.vsix` dropped into `~/.theia/extensions/` already loads today. - [Agents installed on first use from the AI tab](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/47): built; one click installs Claude agent SDK 0.3.332 or Codex 0.172.0 (sha512-pinned) into OwnStudio's folder; the app ships neither; checked by Luiz; a student's sign-in is still open. - [F14 leftovers: stale window title, restore speed on a quiet machine](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/20): the title follows the workbench (Code with no editor says "Code"); 200 restores on a quiet start: median 733 ms, p95 1.38 s, slowest 1.75 s, so S7 holds; a cancelled-token error during restores moved to its own ticket. ## Not yet specified - The build units of slices 2, 3 and 4: they become build tickets when each slice is specified. - The dev skills themselves: build tickets once chosen. - The PhD trial's own build work (recording, consent flow, tutorial content), once the protocol and the tutorial are decided. - Whatever Luiz's slice 1 retest finds. - A lab's own model as a bare OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. a university's ZRR-safe service) driving an agent in the AI tab: whose agent, which tools, takeover or not; for the slice 2 spec. - Where the Pulsim fix ends up (fork or upstream) and how OwnStudio pins it, once decided. ## Out of scope - Averaged simulator target ([ADR 0033](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/step-5/slice-1-thread/docs/adr/0033-averaged-simulator-for-fast-evaluation.md)) and the ST-Link developer slice ([ADR 0035](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/step-5/slice-1-thread/docs/adr/0035-st-link-probe-support.md)): after slice 5. - [Windows installer](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/5); so is the serial-port service of ADR 0031's option 3, which belongs with it. - Upstream pull requests: [Core bootloader script](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/8), [Pulsim's GCC-only flags](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/9). - [Light theme never checked](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/7), [PulsimGUI view of the mission plant](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/10), [adding a data object from the table](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/6).

tickets.title: May OwnStudio redistribute the Claude agent SDK?

lastComment.body:
**Resolution** (what the texts say, not legal advice; [notes](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/research/claude-agent-sdk-licence/research/claude-agent-sdk-licence.md)):
- The SDK is proprietary, under Anthropic's Commercial Terms.
- Shipping Claude Code inside a product is allowed if someone accepts the Commercial Terms, the binary ships unmodified, each user signs in with their own account and is billed directly, and no Claude or Anthropic name or logo appears in OwnStudio's branding.
- Signing in with a Claude subscription (rather than an API key) through the SDK is ambiguous across Anthropic's pages; only Anthropic can settle it. An API key is always fine.
- Codex 0.49 is Apache-2.0 and can be redistributed with its LICENSE, plus the upstream NOTICE, which the npm tarball leaves out.
- The cleanest alternative is the user's own install, which Theia already supports for Claude Code.

Next: [Slice 1 rulings](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/25).

tickets.title: Power and agent shells: what stops an agent switching power on?

lastComment.body:
Input from [Slice 1 rulings](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/25) (Q211–Q219, ADR 0031 amendment):
- Students install their own agents (one click in the AI tab, or any Open VSX extension, or a lab's harness in the terminal). Safety no longer chooses the agent route: it is decided here.
- Start from "the token stops mistakes, not agents": as in VS Code, any agent the student installs can launch the prepared scripts or open the port. OwnStudio's limits (Codex sandbox, no `bypassPermissions`) hold in the AI tab only.
- The open choice is where the real guard lives: the bench (supply limits set by a person, someone present) and/or the port service with the installer (ADR 0031 option 3); and whether AI takeover is offered only in the AI tab.

Can users install the Claude Code and Codex extensions themselves, and what does open extension install risk?

lastComment.body:
**Resolution** ([notes](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/blob/research/agent-extensions/research/agent-extensions.md)):
- Microsoft's marketplace is closed to Theia-based products.
- Both vendors publish verified extensions on Open VSX that fit Theia 1.77's API (1.144). Codex may lose minor features that rely on proposed APIs (not tested).
- When users install an extension themselves, OwnStudio redistributes nothing, and a subscription login is allowed.
- All extensions share one plugin host process: if it crashes, every extension stops (clangd, Pyright, Git), but OwnStudio's own panels keep running.
- Safety: user-installed agents run outside ADR 0031. Claude Code starts in auto mode and ignores the setup's settings for its starting mode; the Codex extension can be switched to Full Access, and that setting is shared with OwnStudio's own Codex.
- A `.vsix` dropped into `~/.theia/extensions/` loads today, even without an Extensions view.

Options for ruling 3: A bundle only · B allow-listed user installs · C both · D the CLI in a terminal · E open installs (not recommended). Next: [Slice 1 rulings](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/25).

tickets.title: Agents installed on first use from the AI tab

lastComment.body:
**Resolution:** done. Luiz's check on 2026-11-25: on a fresh OwnStudio home, both agents installed with one click and answered. The installer carries neither agent; the sandbox probe passes on the pinned Codex 0.172.0 (ca4a71a, ea4439f).

Found during the check: neither agent asked for an account, because each reused a login already on the machine (Claude Code: Luiz's Team subscription in `~/.claude`; Codex: ChatGPT tokens in `~/.codex`). A student's fresh machine has no login, so that step is now its own decision: [Signing in to an installed agent without a terminal](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/49). The lab's own AI is not part of this unit: it comes with [Extensions view on Open VSX](https://github.com/luizvilla/Theia/issues/48) and the slice 2 spec.
